Recipe name

Describe the outcome and how this example uses Nebius Token Factory.

What you will build

Explain the workflow and link to an architecture diagram or screenshot when it helps. Identify the model, framework, and tools used.

Requirements

List the runtime versions, required service accounts, API keys, and local tools. Call out paid API calls and any external resources the recipe creates or changes.

Setup

Provide commands that work from this recipe's directory. Include dependency installation, a blank environment template, and the configuration readers must supply.

Run

Give an exact run command and describe the expected output. Include a small sample input where possible.

Validate

List tests, type checks, and build commands. Separate credential-free checks from live integrations. State what was actually verified, when relevant, and what remains untested.

Limitations and cleanup

Describe the recipe's deployment assumptions, known limitations, and commands to remove resources it creates.

Source and license

Credit the author and upstream project. If importing code, retain its license, record the upstream revision, and describe cookbook-specific changes.
